source: l2jmobius GeoEngine (whole-world constructor, GEODATA_PATH = the set folder): getHeight, hasGeo, getSpawnHeight, getNearestZ/getNextLowerZ/getNextHigherZ, checkNearestNsweAntiCornerCut, isCompletelyBlocked, canSeeTarget, canMoveToTarget, getValidLocation
note: Cases are strings '<inputs> > <outputs>', integers separated by spaces, booleans 0/1. regions: 'rx_ry > present' (0 = no file: NullRegion). height: 'x y z > getHeight hasGeo getSpawnHeight geoX geoY nearestZ nextLowerZ nextHigherZ' (world x y z, geo functions at that world point's cell). nswe: 'geoX geoY z > mask blocked' where bit i of mask is checkNearestNsweAntiCornerCut for E, W, S, N, NE, NW, SE, SW (i = 0..7) and blocked is isCompletelyBlocked. los / can_move: 'x y z tx ty tz instance > result'. valid_location: 'x y z tx ty tz instance > x y z'. All with PathFinding = 2 and AvoidObstructedPathNodes = true (the shipped GeoEngine.ini); variants repeat can_move / valid_location / completely_blocked with one flag flipped. Doors and fences: none (real DoorData / FenceData with no data files). Start points are random cells of each region (70% preference for non-flat blocks, 20% near a region border), z = a layer of the cell plus a small offset, targets within about 5000 units; seed = 20260418 + rx * 100 + ry.
